Creative problem-solving abilities, with a practical approach to implementation. Applies a pragmatic approach to achieving project objectives and can adapt to the needs of the situation. Holding a degree, or equivalent experience or qualification, in an appropriate STEM discipline. Desirable Skills/Qualifications/Experience Experience as a functional team leader, including team administration, career development and pastoral care.
